overall.summary: Numbers reproduce; two weakenings: the heart-rate gate hypothesis gives the 147 bpm threshold that applies only with non-anginal chest pain (about 177 bpm for the typical patient), and the claim that exercise angina erases the female advantage overstates a partial cancellation.

commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify recheck experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779
uv run python -m explaneat verify recheck experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779
uv run python -m explaneat verify recheck experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779

findings.statement: mean-ablating each gate gives AUC 0.938, 0.940, 0.945 (full 0.947); AND gate adds +2.07
findings.check: ablate --to mean each leaf; probe sex x exang
findings.evidence: AUC 0.9382, 0.9405, 0.9446; women with exercise angina get +2.075
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify ablate experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --part ann_32 --to mean
uv run python -m explaneat verify ablate experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --part ann_33 --to mean
uv run python -m explaneat verify ablate experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --part ann_34 --to mean
uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --sweep sex=1,0 --sweep exang=0,1

findings.evidence: with a downsloping segment the gate stays at 0 even at 2.8 mm (upsloping: +1.265)

uv run python -m explaneat verify recheck experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779

findings.statement: raises risk with ST depression, uneven, more with reversible defect
findings.evidence: normal scan: 0 up to 1.2 mm, +0.215 at 1.5, +1.265 at 2.8; reversible defect: on from 0.5 mm, +2.128 at 2.8 (risk 27% -> 76%)
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --sweep oldpeak=0,0.5,1.0,1.2,1.5,2,2.8 --sweep thal=3,7
uv run python -m explaneat verify ablate experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --part ann_32 --to mean

findings.statement: raises risk only for women with exercise angina (n=19)
findings.evidence: contribution +2.075 only for women with exercise angina, 0 in the other three cells; n=19, 12 with disease
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --sweep sex=1,0 --sweep exang=0,1
uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --where "sex == '0' and exang == '1'"

findings.statement: the network learns that exercise angina erases the female advantage
findings.evidence: women with exercise angina get 1.6% against 11.6% for men with it (and 0.2% without): the gate cancels part of the female term (+2.07 of a 3.32 logit gap), it does not erase the advantage
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --sweep sex=1,0 --sweep exang=0,1

findings.statement: maximum heart rate changes nothing until about 147 beats per minute, then lowers the risk (stated without qualification)
findings.check: probe thalach x chest pain type
findings.evidence: 147 bpm is the threshold for patients with non-anginal chest pain; for the typical patient (no chest pain) the part stays at 0 up to 175 bpm and switches on near 177 bpm (-0.265 at 180). Active in 80% of non-anginal patients vs 10.5% of others
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --sweep thalach=130,140,145,147,150,160,170,175,180,190 --sweep cp=4,3
uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --where "cp == '3'"

findings.statement: active 80% of cp:3 vs 10.5% others; mean-ablation AUC ->0.945
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-81f779 --where "cp == '3'"
